semiconductor_relevance: High — Wonik IPS is a key player in the semiconductor equipment industry, specializing in advanced deposition systems and process equipment.
summary: Wonik IPS Co., Ltd. develops and supplies advanced thin film deposition systems and process equipment for semiconductor fabrication. With a strong focus on R&D, they have pioneered technologies such as ALD and CVD systems, catering to the needs of various semiconductor applications including DRAM and NAND flash.
capabilities: Mold process systems for 3D NAND flash

regional_presence.Korea: Wonik IPS has significantly contributed to Korea's semiconductor equipment industry since its foundation in 1991.
